strategy.line: A brand identity without strategy is decoration.
strategy.note: We start with the one true thing no competitor can copy, then design the system that carries it, so the identity means something, not just looks like something. It begins with the name; if you already have one, we rebrand around it. See what it costs →

proof.note: A brand identity reads best whole. Look at how a complete system comes together, end to end.

faq.a: Brand identity design is creating the system a company is recognised by: name, logo, type, colour, voice and motion, plus the guidelines that keep them consistent. Done well, people know you before they finish reading.

faq.q: What is the difference between a brand identity and a logo?
faq.a: A logo is one mark. A brand identity is the whole system the logo lives inside: type, colour, voice, motion, and the rules that hold them together. The logo is the signature; the identity is the handwriting.

faq.q: What is included in a brand identity from OOVERT?
faq.a: Depending on the tier: strategy and positioning, naming, logo and mark, typography, colour, voice, motion, and full guidelines with every source file. It is listed in full before you buy, and it is yours on final payment.

faq.q: How long does brand identity design take?
faq.a: Fixed-scope work ships in two to five working days. A full strategy-led identity runs a few weeks, because the thinking cannot be rushed. You get a real date before we start.

faq.q: How much does a brand identity cost?
faq.a: Ours start at $280, against a US average of about $7,500. There are one-time, monthly and embedded options. The full pricing lays them out.

closing.note: Tell us about the company and what you want it to stand for. We design the identity that makes it impossible to miss.
